# Timer

Card type `custom:houseview-timer-card`, or `type: timer` in the `cards` list of `custom:houseview-card`. Available since 1.0.

A kitchen timer for a `timer.*` entity: the countdown, four preset buttons (5, 10, 15 and 30 minutes), pause or
resume, cancel, and a **Custom** button that opens on long press the more-info dialog, where Home Assistant offers any duration.

* A preset calls `timer.start` with `duration` in seconds. When the timer is already running or paused, the widget
  asks "Replace the running kitchen timer?" first (`confirm_mode: inline` shows the question inside the card).
* Pause calls `timer.pause`, resume calls `timer.start` without a duration (the remaining time is kept), cancel calls
  `timer.cancel`. Pause, resume and cancel are disabled unless the timer is active or paused.
* The countdown reads `finishes_at` while the timer is active and `remaining` while it is paused. It shows `Ready`
  when idle and `Unavailable` when the entity is missing.
* **Alarm.** When an active timer goes idle within 10 seconds of its `finishes_at`, the card shows a banner
  ("Kitchen timer finished · Tap to dismiss") and plays six short beeps. Browsers only allow sound after a touch, so
  the audio is unlocked by the first tap on the card; until then the banner is silent. The audio context is closed
  when the card is removed from the page. A timer that is cancelled early does not ring.
* **Timer display.** While the timer runs, the [timer display](../overviews/timer.md) overview takes the whole
  screen. Turn it off with `timer_display: false` on the card.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| entity | entity | required | A `timer.*` entity |
| name | string | friendly name | Label |
| size | normal/wide/tall/large | normal | Widget size on carousel pages |

```yaml
type: custom:houseview-timer-card
entity: timer.kitchen
```
